verdict.rationale: Pigment documents detailed application histories down to the data block level that give visibility into edit events, and an Audit Trail API that exports application and administration events to a SIEM. That covers the logging half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows changes can be rolled back; staging changes in testing environments before production is a different control and earns no rollback credit. Missing for 10: any documented rollback or restore of model changes, explicit confirmation that logs capture who/what/when per change, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every change to the model is logged with who changed what and when, and can be rolled back

citations.quote: your applications each have detailed histories down to the data block level, which offer full visibility into the edit events
With the Audit Trail API, you can ingest login, administration, security and application events into your SIEM
